name: PizzNdos Let's Eat
why_it_matters: Tripadvisor #1 of 2 verified-review restaurants in Haflong (5.0, small sample). Third-floor seating on Main Road near Central Bank with views toward the Borail hills — the only Haflong place where you can pair sit-down food with a hill view. Useful if you've been eating local for days and want a pizza/pasta reset.
insider_tip: Generous portions, low prices for the quality. Wood-fired pizza takes 25-30 min; order on arrival. Vegetarian options are stronger than the meat-heavy Dimasa cuisine you'll find elsewhere in Haflong.
signature_address: 3rd Floor, Main Road, Near Central Bank, Haflong, Dima Hasao District, Assam 788819

name: Bobho Restaurant
why_it_matters: Haflong's most-reviewed sit-down — 452 Justdial reviews (3.9). Opposite the Lal Field & Town Committee Office in Dibari, on the main road. Mainstream Chinese / North Indian / South Indian — the default workday lunch in Haflong, not the heritage Dimasa meal. 10am-8pm so plan around the early shut.
insider_tip: Closes at 8pm — Haflong eats early. Authentic Dimasa cuisine (judima rice wine, gudok, yumra chutney) is a homestay-and-festival experience, not a restaurant one; don't expect it here.
signature_address: Main Road, Opposite Lal Field & Town Committee Office, Dibari, Haflong, Dima Hasao District, Assam 788819
